name: Jun Yamazaki
source:
A geeky second year whose diagnosis of osteoporosis prevents her from having any physically taxing hobbies, Jun feels most at home behind a computer screen and in that capacity is usually the go-to girl for editing jobs at Yamaku's newspaper club.

A recent bone fracture in her arm temporarily forced her away from her club duties, though she was relieved to hear that a replacement was on the way. The editor-in-chief did warn her that her temporary replacement was a bit on the shy side.
